contradictions.explanation: If Mina, Fay, and Jude are all pairwise in different houses, that requires at least three distinct houses among just these three students, which is possible with exactly three houses, but combined with Wren and Xavi also needing house assignments in only three houses total, it creates an over-constrained set that cannot consistently be satisfied without additional information, making the pairwise distinctness claims unverifiable as jointly consistent.
